intention: Adjudication entries in the operator inbox carry a subject line so the operator can identify them at a glance without looking up the berth.
traces_to: Law 5 — the address carries what a mind needs NOW

falsifier.proves_red: Run cairn operator_inbox after the change. (1) Every adjudication entry created after the change shows a subject line that identifies what the finding is about. (2) An entry that says only 'nothing noticed at capture' with no subject is the failure.

how: emit_finding gains an optional subject kwarg included in the finding's data alongside bullets. Each skill door passes it: idea passes the slug, intent passes the what, sorted passes the ticket title. The inbox script's adjudication section shows the subject.
